entries.title: Dear Google, Apple, Mozilla, and MS: Please End Auto-Playing Media in Browsers
entries.author: geuis
entries.current_title: Dear Google, Apple, Mozilla, and MS: Please End Auto-Playing Media in Browsers
entries.excerpt: I know there are plugins than can somewhat do this, but no solutions are universal or great. Please update all of our browsers so that no automatic video/audio can play without user interaction/permission. Its getting to be impossible to visit many sites today without being bombarded by video and sound playing by default on the web. In the worst cases such as on mobile browsers like iOS Safari, visiting a site will start playing media that kills whatever you're already listen
entries.guide_zh: 发帖者呼吁主要浏览器厂商停止默认自动播放音频与视频。

entries.title: Ask HN: Who is firing?
entries.author: wellworld
entries.excerpt: The startup I work at will soon be undergoing an exodus of staff due to a failure in leadership and management by the founders. Really painful, sad, situation for all involved. So, I figure if we're allowed to talk about who is hiring, why not the other way around? At the very least, we can get a pulse on those companies which smells like roses on the outside, and reek of something more earthy on the inside.
entries.guide_zh: 经历公司管理失误后，发帖者邀请社区讨论哪些公司正在裁员或流失员工。

entries.title: Tell HN: Riseup.net fails to update canary; fingerprints deleted without notice
entries.author: orthoganol
entries.current_title: Tell HN: Riseup.net fails to update canary; fingerprints deleted without notice
entries.excerpt: After almost a week of direct questioning, canary is still not updated: https://riseup.net/pl/about-us/canary Certificate fingerprints deleted for certain domains on Oct. 22nd without notice: https://github.com/riseupnet/riseup_help/commit/8a8c98e0aaa635130a899c1980569f34633d159d Page where fingerprints no longer appear: https://riseup.net/pl/security/network-security/certificates
entries.guide_zh: 作者注意到 Riseup 的金丝雀声明未更新、证书指纹消失，追问相关变化。

entries.title: Ask HN: How Can I Get into NLP (Natural Language Processing)?
entries.author: aarohmankad
entries.current_title: Ask HN: How Can I Get into NLP (Natural Language Processing)?
entries.excerpt: I've recently become quite intrigued by the concept, and want to learn more about it. If you have any resources, I'd love to see them. They can be videos, articles, tutorials, courses, etc. If there is any prerequisite knowledge required, which I assume there will be, I would also love a starting point. As for my background, I have experience in full stack web development, game development, and about a year's worth of academic computer science study.
entries.guide_zh: 对自然语言处理产生兴趣，作者寻找从入门到深入的学习资源。
